battle_phases.completion_condition: Ansel is deployed at frame 1320, both vanguards remain alive, and no opening runner has leaked.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An early leak fails acceptance; a pioneer death can also invalidate the later deployment ledger.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four-corridor interception while preserving the economic opening.
handoff_requirements: Opening lower interception remains Midnight's duty until his scheduled withdrawal.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla block and support adjacent central lanes.
Midnight and Melantha intercept the outer openings and begin eastern device clearance.
Lancet supplies supported recovery and withdraws at frame 1290.
survival_dependencies: Both pioneers must survive to deliver the DP grants used by later purchases.
Midnight must remain viable after Lancet's earlier withdrawal; ordinary healing cannot be assumed outside range.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both opening outer hostile queues are dead by their withdrawals, Hibiscus is deployed, and Steward is active.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Unfinished opening enemies become unstaffed outer threats; medical or economic failure undermines artillery clearance and final blocking.
battle_phases.goal: Complete opening interception and establish separated medical sectors.
handoff_requirements: Midnight passes unfinished eastern lower clearance to Lava.
Melantha's vacated upper tile is reserved for Beagle.
responsibilities: Steward begins sustained eastern artillery coverage after the corrected purchase.
Hibiscus treats Vanilla from the new lower-sector position.
battle_phases.start_condition: Ansel begins upper-sector treatment at second 44.
survival_dependencies: Upper treatment must prevent Fang's survival and income chain from failing.
Vanilla must reach the lower medical handoff alive.
Outer opening completion is predicted rather than guaranteed by the withdrawal times.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All eastern roadblocks and western upper roadblock are destroyed, fresh outer defenders are installed, and the upper civilian reaches its objective.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Artillery survival or detained-civilian exposure can cause objective failure even if the deployment ledger remains affordable.
battle_phases.goal: Preserve artillery output and release protected routes without exposing civilians to officers.
handoff_requirements: Gallus yields a slot to Beagle.
Steward retains artillery responsibility when Lava leaves.
Cardigan must be established before Melantha begins western lower work.
responsibilities: Lava finishes eastern lower detention and contributes at the lower artillery stop.
Ansel and Hibiscus sustain their own sectors using the revised enhancement windows.
Beagle and Cardigan intercept later outer officers.
battle_phases.start_condition: Opening outer operators have withdrawn and the two medical sectors are established.
survival_dependencies: Two-column separation must reduce harmful shared exposure enough for actual healing to sustain the eastern attackers; immunity is not presumed.
Gallus must complete western upper clearance before his withdrawal.
Lava must free eastern lower detention before nearby officers can attack its civilian.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Western lower detention is destroyed, the lower civilian safely arrives, Midnight occupies the explicitly vacated central tile, and Durin is deployed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An incomplete device task endangers the second protected arrival; an interrupted central handoff exposes the final runner and armored waves.
battle_phases.goal: Finish lower civilian protection and install continuous central arts.
handoff_requirements: Melantha yields her slot only after predicted device completion.
responsibilities: Melantha clears western lower detention with ordinary attacks.
Midnight inherits Vanilla's lower central block; Durin attacks both central blocking positions.
battle_phases.start_condition: Cardigan holds lower outer traffic and Melantha redeploys at second 146.
survival_dependencies: Cardigan must hold officers away from the western civilian without credited self-healing.
Both medics and Fang must survive the artillery excursion.
The central handoff requires Vanilla alive and holding until the listed retreat.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Remaining life is positive, leaks and protected deaths are zero, both civilians have arrived, spawns are exhausted and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak, protected death, missing protected arrival or surviving enemy prevents project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Clear the final schedule and every surviving enemy with both protected objectives secured.
handoff_requirements: Keep every interception position until its queue is empty.
Validate protected arrival events independently from hostile-clearance events.
responsibilities: Fang, Midnight, Beagle and Cardigan retain their respective corridors.
Durin supplies continuous arts between Midnight's legal skill windows.
Both medics sustain their sectors, and Steward finishes any target still within supported coverage.
battle_phases.start_condition: Terminal formation is established at second 173.
survival_dependencies: Outer defenders must retain enough ordinary durability to finish their queues.
Central damage and healing must clear armored backlogs without overflowing block capacity.
Artillery must actually die; departure from its eastern coverage is a clearance failure rather than an assumed victory.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns sustained artillery clearance. Opening Midnight and lower-stop Lava contribute only when actual target selection permits. Verify artillery death rather than infer it from elapsed coverage.
Melantha clears eastern roadblock #3; Gallus clears western #1. Beagle intercepts later officers. Independently record the upper civilian's safe arrival.

Midnight starts eastern #4, Lava finishes it, and redeployed Melantha clears western #2. Cardigan separates later officers from western detention. Independently record the lower civilian's safe arrival.
Fang blocks upper central traffic throughout; Vanilla initially assists, followed by Midnight and Durin. Ansel owns Fang's treatment.
Vanilla blocks lower central traffic until second 172; Midnight then inherits blocking. Hibiscus treats the lower central formation, and Durin supplies continuous arts.
Melantha handles the opening outer runner and officer. Beagle handles subsequent upper officers under Ansel and remains until her queue is empty.
Midnight handles the opening lower runner and officer. Cardigan handles subsequent lower officers through ordinary three-block durability and attacks; no unsupported self-heal is credited.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper central blocking, reciprocal opening damage and conditional automatic DP.
Lower central blocking and manual DP until the explicit terminal handoff.
Opening lower outer interception, partial eastern lower roadblock clearance and opportunistic artillery damage.
Opening upper outer interception and eastern upper roadblock clearance.
Opening global recovery and local treatment; withdraw at second 43.
Upper medical sector: Fang, upper outer interceptor, Steward and self.
Ordinary arts clearance of western upper roadblock.
Primary continuous attacker across the eastern artillery vertical and both eastern stops.
Lower medical sector: Vanilla, Lava, terminal Midnight, terminal Durin and self.
Inherit unfinished eastern lower roadblock clearance and attack the lower eastern artillery stop.
Fresh upper outer three-block interception under Ansel.
Fresh lower outer three-block interception; ordinary durability without credited self-healing.
Redeployed western lower roadblock clearance behind Cardigan.
Terminal lower central blocker and periodic arts damage across both central blocking tiles.
Continuous terminal arts into both central blocking tiles, within Hibiscus's basic range.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward retains the original full eastern vertical coverage. Lava retains lower-stop coverage. Their survival depends on sector healing and reduced shared exposure; target ordering remains uncredited.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel [2,5] RIGHT covers rows 1-3 and columns 5-8. Hibiscus [5,5] RIGHT covers rows 4-6 and columns 5-8. Each eastern attacker is two columns ahead of its medic. Neither reciprocal medic coverage nor blast immunity is assumed.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla cover adjacent central blocking tiles. Midnight and Melantha intercept the two outer openings and work on eastern roadblocks.
formation_structure.protection: Gallus clears upper western detention. Redeployed Melantha clears lower western detention. Fresh outer defenders hold officers at least two columns east of the western roadblocks.
formation_structure.terminal: Fang, Midnight, Beagle, Cardigan, Ansel, Hibiscus, Steward and Durin occupy eight slots. Durin uses [5,6], leaving Hibiscus's new [5,5] tile unobstructed.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet at second 43, before the saved frame-1333 death. Opening outer survival after withdrawal remains a required dependency.
Deploy Steward at second 60 with 19 modeled DP available for an 18-DP purchase; remove the unfunded second-58 deployment.
Add Hibiscus's lower treatment sector. Midnight still occupies his separate outer tile until frame 2115.
Withdraw opening Midnight; unfinished roadblock #4 passes explicitly to Lava.
Withdraw opening Melantha after her predicted upper opening clearance; her redeployment cooldown starts here.
Lava occupies the eastern lower high ground and inherits roadblock #4.
Withdraw Gallus after predicted western upper clearance, then deploy Beagle on Melantha's vacated tile.
Deploy Cardigan before the paired lower officers reach the interception tile.
Withdraw Lava and deploy Melantha for western lower clearance. Steward retains artillery responsibility; this transition does not certify artillery death.
Withdraw Melantha, explicitly withdraw Vanilla, then deploy Midnight on the freed [4,5] tile.
Deploy Durin on [5,6] DOWN for immediate central arts without occupying Hibiscus's tile.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity between 1 and 3 inclusive, and qualification.normal_mode true; no mode-specific reserve unit is used.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col], a listed deployable terrain tile and an explicit cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight operators are deployed. Execute listed retreats before same-frame replacements; Hibiscus owns [5,5], and terminal Durin owns [5,6].

No retreat refund or unsupported income is budgeted. Steward's former frame-1740 purchase is replaced by frame 1800. Failed survival-dependent DP grants invalidate downstream purchases and constitute formation failure.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblock destruction does not itself prove safe arrival.
Destroy eastern detention before later officers can attack waiting civilians; keep western detention separated from officers by the outer interception line until clearance and safe arrival.
Ansel covers the upper sector and Hibiscus the lower sector. Do not assume mutual healing, arbitrary target selection, probabilistic talents or immunity from two-tile separation.

Each predicted withdrawal requires the predecessor's hostile queue or device task to be complete. These requirements are verification assertions, not executable conditional guards or permission to move actions automatically.
Count only observed damage and death. Timing changes do not establish target order, splash radius or build equivalence. Lava's withdrawal never certifies artillery death.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish all four opening interception duties, obtain the first supported DP grants, provide Lancet's recovery and withdraw her before the recorded fatal exposure.
Establish upper treatment, western upper clearance and funded primary artillery coverage. Add lower treatment and complete the opening outer withdrawals.
Keep both central economic anchors alive. Lava inherits eastern lower clearance; Gallus finishes western upper clearance. Preserve both artillery attackers with separated medical sectors.
Install fresh outer defenders, release both civilians from eastern detention before nearby officers can attack them, and sustain eastern artillery output through the targeted healing windows.
Melantha clears western lower detention while Steward continues artillery work. Execute the explicit lower central handoff and add Durin.
Hold all four hostile corridors through the final officer, runner and armored schedules. Confirm both protected arrivals and artillery death.
Maintain interception, healing and repeated central arts until spawns are exhausted and every active enemy is cleared. Require the complete acceptance predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic +6 DP at seconds 19,44,69 and each subsequent 25-second interval is conditional on survival and continuous deployment.
Manual +6 DP and ATK enhancement at seconds 25,55,85,115,145; account for the ten-second active SP pause.
Opening arts at 61; redeployment resets readiness, permitting terminal arts at 212 and 322. No SP recovery is credited during the forty-second active duration.
Opening ATK enhancement at 70. Her second deployment relies on ordinary attacks because its scheduled duration is shorter than skill readiness.

Hold the first ready skill until 90, then activate every sixty seconds. Prioritize sustained upper eastern exposure while respecting twenty-five active seconds plus thirty-five charging seconds. Do not assume an equal-ratio healing tie-break.
Hold the first ready skill until 117, then activate every fifty seconds. Support the lower eastern pressure and subsequent central fighting without crediting unsupported talent ATK.
Deployment at 95 grants thirty supported SP; activate at 105. Credit attack-speed improvement to ordinary attacks, without splash geometry.
DEF enhancement at 151 provides an exposure buffer; it is not treated as a major improvement against minimum-damage officer attacks.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks without highest-defense priority or unsupported talent ATK.
Use ordinary attacks and supported blocking only; exclude RES reduction, self-healing and evasion.

tactical_thesis: Replace the failed reciprocal medical formation with separate upper and lower treatment sectors. Place each medic two columns behind its eastern artillery attacker, redirect healing toward its central blocker, and reserve healing enhancements for sustained eastern exposure. Preserve the demonstrated four-roadblock protection structure while correcting Lancet's withdrawal, Steward's deployment funding, and every occupation handoff. Increased artillery uptime is a survival hypothesis requiring verification, not a fixed extra-damage calculation or an assumed kill.
